title: Chargeback Fee Returned on a Won Case, Northloop Payments
content:
**Rule.** A chargeback fee is returned only on a case whose dispute is recorded as won, and it is booked as one fee-return entry on that case. The fee returned on a won case is the chargeback fee charged on that case when the plan returns the chargeback fee on a win, and nothing when it does not, rounded to the cent.

## Elements

| Element | Reading |
|---|---|
| Won case | a chargeback case whose dispute is recorded as won |
| Chargeback fee charged on the case | the chargeback fee booked as charged on that case on the Northloop Payments ledger |
| Whether the plan returns the fee on a win | the payout plan's term on returning the chargeback fee when the seller wins the dispute |

## Outcome by plan term

| The payout plan returns the chargeback fee on a win | Fee returned on the won case |
|---|---|
| yes | the chargeback fee charged on the case, rounded to the cent |
| no | nothing |

## Hypothetical worked examples

- *Payments Enterprise (returns the fee on a win), chargeback fee 10.00 USD charged on the case, dispute won.* The fee returned is 10.00 USD.
- *Payments Weekly (does not return the fee on a win), chargeback fee 20.00 USD, dispute won.* The fee returned is nothing.
- *Any plan, dispute lost.* The case is not recorded as won, and no fee is returned on it.
